title: Monotonicity of the time bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $T_1,T_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(n)\le T_2(n)$ for every $n$. If $N$ satisfies the stated one-sided-error decision condition for $L$ within time $T_1$, then it satisfies that condition within time $T_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$L$ is a language of binary strings
$T_1,T_2$ map natural numbers to natural numbers
$N$ satisfies the one-sided-error time-decision condition with bound $T_1$
